verdict.rationale: Riveter docs describe scheduling enrichment projects to run repeatedly ('Schedule any project to monitor for changes... refresh as often as every minute'), which supports recurring-job automation for its core enrichment workflows. However, the evidence pack lacks API/SDK details for configuring schedule cadence, cron-like controls, or triggering broader multi-step workflows beyond single enrichment refreshes. Missing for 10: documented scheduling API/parameters, support for scheduling arbitrary workflows (not just enrichment refresh), and independent confirmation of reliability.
